representation: A 2D graph of f(x) = cos x with Taylor polynomials P2, P4 and P6 around x = 0, sharing axes, a center marker and a text legend.
motion: the terms slider reveals P2, P4 and P6 in sequence
checkpoints: at the center all approximations agree
away from the center the curves separate
more terms improve a local fit, not global equality
misconceptionTest: At x = 0 every curve agrees, while near the edges even P6 separates from cos x. This directly contradicts global equality and the claim that more terms always help everywhere.
accessibility: Every curve has a text label, the legend does not rely on color, the slider is keyboard accessible, alt text describes the graph, and reduced motion stops the marker pulse.
